coverage: One shared original Domyouji36 monochrome font atlas; exact blocks and metrics equal in eight language resources. Does not claim all HUD or dynamic fonts.
limitations: Runtime shader/LOD compatibility must be observed; retain fallback when unsupported.
Interpolation preserves original glyph shape and metrics; it does not create new typographic detail.
Original low alpha=1 BC3 residue outside glyph rectangles retained; no visible glyph pixels discarded.
